counts.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE tenant_id='demo') invoices,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE tenant_id='demo') receipts,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_entries WHERE tenant_id='demo') time_entries;

division_sums.sql: SELECT p.division,COUNT(*) projects,SUM(p.contract_amount_usd) contract_usd,SUM((SELECT SUM(i.amount_usd) FROM invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.project_id=p.id)) invoice_usd,SUM((SELECT SUM(CASE r.kind WHEN 'refund' THEN -r.amount_usd ELSE r.amount_usd END) FROM receipts r JOIN invoices i ON i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.id=r.invoice_id WHERE i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.project_id=p.id)) net_receipt_usd,SUM((SELECT SUM(t.hours) FROM time_entries t WHERE t.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND t.project_id=p.id)) hours FROM projects p WHERE p.tenant_id='demo' GROUP BY p.division ORDER BY p.division;

financial_totals.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(contract_amount_usd) FROM projects WHERE tenant_id='demo') contracts,(SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices WHERE tenant_id='demo') invoices,(SELECT SUM(CASE kind WHEN 'refund' THEN -amount_usd ELSE amount_usd END) FROM receipts WHERE tenant_id='demo') net_receipts,100.0*(SELECT SUM(CASE kind WHEN 'refund' THEN -amount_usd ELSE amount_usd END) FROM receipts WHERE tenant_id='demo')/(SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices WHERE tenant_id='demo') receipt_pct,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE tenant_id='demo' AND kind='refund') refunds;

orphans.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND p.id=i.project_id)) invoice_projects,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipts r WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.id=r.invoice_id)) receipt_invoices,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_entries t WHERE t.project_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND p.id=t.project_id)) time_projects,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM time_entries t WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND u.id=t.user_id)) time_users;

nonpositive_amounts.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE amount_usd<=0) invoices,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE amount_usd<=0) receipts;

invoice_counts_ranges.sql: SELECT p.id,COUNT(i.id) invoices,MIN(i.amount_usd) min_usd,MAX(i.amount_usd) max_usd,SUM(i.amount_usd) invoice_total,p.contract_amount_usd contract FROM projects p LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.project_id=p.id WHERE p.tenant_id='demo' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id;

weekly_staff_totals.sql: SELECT user_id,week_start,SUM(hours) hours FROM time_entries WHERE tenant_id='demo' GROUP BY user_id,week_start ORDER BY user_id,week_start;

activity_validity.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) invalid FROM time_entries WHERE activity NOT IN ('administration','coordination','technical','report_processing','client_meetings','economic','pto','vacation') OR (activity IN ('pto','vacation') AND project_id IS NOT NULL);

assigned_only.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) invalid FROM time_entries t WHERE t.tenant_id='demo' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND m.project_id=t.project_id AND m.user_id=t.user_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_profiles s JOIN users u ON u.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND s.user_id=t.user_id AND u.role='specialist'));

project_staff_weeks.sql: SELECT project_id,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) specialists,COUNT(DISTINCT week_start) weeks FROM time_entries WHERE tenant_id='demo' GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id;

weeks.sql: SELECT DISTINCT week_start FROM time_entries WHERE tenant_id='demo' ORDER BY week_start;

activity_counts.sql: SELECT activity,COUNT(*) entries FROM time_entries WHERE tenant_id='demo' GROUP BY activity ORDER BY activity;
